newsitem.title: USA: Brazos Sportswear says to buy Morning Sun.
newsitem.headline: Brazos Sportswear says to buy Morning Sun.

text.p: Brazos Sportswear Inc said on Tuesday that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Morning Sun Inc, a privately held apparel maker, in a $30 million deal.

The $30 million purchase price includes the assumption of indebtedness and contractual obligations of about $14 million, Brazos said in a statement, as well as the issuance of 73,171 shares of Brazos common stock.
The acquisition is subject to regulatory approvals and financing of the transaction, and is expected to occur by July 15, the company said.
Brazos Sportswear is a manufacturer and distributor of decorated sportswear with annualized revenues of about $250 million, the company said.
Morning Sun is a designer and manufacturer of embroidered and screen printed fleece wear, with annual revenues of about $55 million.
